name: Just Forgot to Eat
summary: In this game you are someone who has just moved house for your job, but because at home you are a very spoiled and forgetful person, so you always forget to eat, one day you wake up from your sleep because you are hungry, the clock shows 01:00 AM, you haven't eaten since yesterday morning, so now you have to go out and look for a food stall that is still open, but in the middle of the road you find a woman, she is crying in fear...
